result.short_description: Patient appointment data out of sync across portal and scheduling
result.description: Multiple patients report appointment times showing differently in the portal vs the scheduling system. The patient-records-sync service appears to be dropping updates during concurrent writes. Approximately 340 appointments affected since 2026-09-28 15:00 UTC.
result.resolution_notes: Root cause: optimistic locking not applied to patient record sync. Fix deployed via HLTH-104 hotfix. 340 stale appointments corrected by reconciliation script.

result.short_description: PHI field encryption key rotation failed on secondary replica
result.description: Automated key rotation for AES-256-GCM PHI encryption completed on primary but failed on the read replica due to connection timeout. Fallback to previous key succeeded. No data exposure.
result.resolution_notes: Extended replica connection timeout from 30s to 120s. Key rotation retry succeeded. No PHI exposure confirmed by audit log review.

result.short_description: Emergency deploy: fix patient sync race condition
result.description: Deploy hotfix for HLTH-104 to resolve the patient appointment data sync failure (INC0050201). Adds optimistic locking to the sync service write path.

result.short_description: Scheduled: extend PHI encryption to appointment metadata
result.description: Extend AES-256-GCM encryption to cover appointment notes and provider comments. Part of HIPAA compliance hardening (HLTH-102).
